text:
maria: heads-up — since 02:12 UTC we've seen a large spike in time-series from gpu_exporter in us-west2 after the node autoscaler churn. remote_write queue depth on cortex-proxy spiked ~5x and write latency p95 went to ~30s. logs show repeated 502/504 + 429 from write replicas.
benjamin: ugh, any relay logs or relabel configs? could be a label explosion causing backpressure.
maria: pasting a snippet from the exporter relabeling in the DaemonSet — I think a regex is wrong and we end up duplicating node serials into gpu_id: ```relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_serial]
  regex: (.*)\/(.*)
  target_label: gpu_id
```
maria: when autoscaler re-creates nodes it seems both node and pod labels are matching, producing multiple series per device. exporter's metrics per GPU go from ~1 to 3-4 series each.
kai: that will blow up cardinality. how many new series? rough numbers?
maria: from target set ~4k -> ~28k series for gpu metrics in us-west2. remote_write bundle size increased and retried.
prometheus-bot: ALERT: remote_write_queue_depth (cortex-proxy) > 1000 for 5m in cluster prod-us-west2, firing at 02:17 UTC.
olivia: paging? i'm oncall. first step: reduce scrape frequency for gpu_exporter to 60s and increase `scrape_timeout` to 30s? or the opposite?
benjamin: reduce scrape frequency (move to 60s) + add relabel drop rule to drop duplicate node labels is safer. also temporarily rate-limit the exporter via pacemaker.
kai: suggestion for relabel rule to drop pod-level duplicates: ```relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name, __meta_kubernetes_node_name]
  regex: (.+)\1
  action: drop
``` — hmm that regex is wrong, just brainstorming.
maria: ok i'll patch the daemonset to fix regex to only capture serial suffix: ```relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_serial]
  regex: ^([A-Za-z0-9_-]{8})$
  target_label: gpu_id
  action: replace
```
benjamin: also on the cortex side we should enable `remote_write.max_shards_in_flight=2` and bump queue capacity temporarily. olivia can you open an incident ticket and tag ops?
olivia: opening INC-2026-347 in ops-incidents and tagging @oncall. adding runbook notes: 1) patch relabeling, 2) reduce scrape rate, 3) throttle exporter, 4) increase remote_write queue and roll back after backpressure clears.
maria: i'm going to roll a canary patch to dev first (us-west2-dev) with the regex fix and reduced scrape interval. will report back in 10m.
kai: also add a short-term grafana panel for "gpu_exporter series count by job" and an alert threshold so we catch cardinality spikes earlier.
benjamin: good — once canary green, promote. we should also add an automated relabel test in CI to catch label-mangling before deploy.
maria: canary applied to dev, initial metrics look much narrower. remote_write queue on canary proxy is stable. patching prod next.
olivia: thanks — incident INC-2026-347 created, priority P2. adding postmortem checklist.
prometheus-bot: INFO: remote_write queue depth normalized for prod-us-west2 at 02:45 UTC.
maria: prod patch applied, queue down, series count back to baseline. leaving follow-ups: add CI relabel test, grafana panel, and a short doc explaining common exporter label pitfalls.
benjamin: assign follow-ups to the infra backlog and me for CI test. great job everyone. :thumbsup:
